diagnosis: Customer on Legacy Auth planning the migration to Unified Auth.
reply: Thanks for reaching out. Migration replaces account-wide tokens with scoped keys. Plan for a dual-running window: create scoped keys, cut traffic over, then disable the legacy token. Please note the migration cannot be reversed once legacy tokens are disabled, so keep the dual-running window until you are confident. See "Migrating from Legacy Auth to Unified Auth" (kb-0012) for the full details.
